design_gotchas.title: No Enable (EN) Pin and No True Load Disconnect
design_gotchas.detail: TPS613221ADBVR is an always-on 3-active-pin boost converter in SOT-23-5 (pins 3 and 5 are NC) with no EN or shutdown pin. When VIN is present, current flows directly to VOUT through the inductor and high-side body diode, so external load switching is required if system shutdown is needed.

design_gotchas.title: 1.2 A Is Switch Current Limit, Not Continuous Load Current
design_gotchas.detail: The 1.2 A typical (0.75 A minimum) rating is the internal low-side switch current limit, not guaranteed output load current. From a single 1.2 V alkaline cell boosting to 3.3 V, maximum deliverable load current is typically under 300 mA due to boost duty cycle and inductor ripple.

design_gotchas.title: Family Pinout Reversal Trap Between 3-Pin DBZ Variants
design_gotchas.detail: While TPS613221ADBVR uses SOT-23-5 (DBV: 1=SW, 2=GND, 4=VOUT), the 3-pin SOT-23 (DBZ) siblings reverse Pin 1 and Pin 3 between non-A (TPS61322xDBZ: 1=SW, 2=VOUT, 3=GND) and A-suffix (TPS61322xADBZ: 1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=SW) devices. Never assume family pin compatibility across packages or suffixes.

design_gotchas.title: High Output Current (> 350 mA) Requires Parallel External Schottky Diode
design_gotchas.detail: For output currents above ~350 mA or VIN near 0.9 V, TI recommends placing a low-Vf Schottky diode in parallel between SW and VOUT to share freewheeling current and reduce switching spikes on the 6.0 V rated SW pin.

typical_use_cases: Single-cell or dual-cell alkaline/NiMH battery (0.9 V to 3.0 V) boost to fixed 3.3 V MCU rail
Ultra-low quiescent current (6.5 uA) always-on IoT sensors, smart meters, and wearables
Minimal-BOM 3-component boost power stage (IC, 2.2 uH inductor, ceramic Cout) without feedback resistors
engineering_summary: The TPS613221ADBVR is an ultra-low quiescent current (6.5 uA typ into VOUT) synchronous hysteretic boost converter in SOT-23-5 (DBV) providing a fixed 3.3 V output from 0.9 V to 5.5 V inputs (operating down to 0.4 V after startup). With a 1.2 A typical (0.75 A min) internal switch limit, 2.2 uH nominal inductor, and zero feedback resistors, it minimizes BOM count for single/dual-cell battery systems. Note that it lacks an EN pin and true load disconnect; engineers considering alternatives must verify pinout, shutdown behavior, and switch-current-limited load capacity against the official TI datasheet before production.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.3 confirmed DBV 5-pin SOT-23 Top View pinout (1=SW, 2=GND, 3=NC, 4=VOUT, 5=NC) with no exposed pad and distinguished it from 3-pin DBZ variants.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.4 verified Abs Max 6.0 V, Rec Op VIN 0.9-5.5 V, RthetaJA 189.7 C/W, RthetaJC(top) 109.4 C/W, L 2.2 uH, and min Cout 4.7 uF.
300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.6 Fig 6-3 verified TPS613221A peak efficiency ~94% at VIN = 3.0 V, VOUT = 3.3 V.
